description: Pakistan Railways, the state railway operator under the Ministry of Railways, publishes its Year Book on its website. On 28 September 2026 the Year Book page listed ten editions, from 2015-2016 to 2024-2025, each as a PDF. The year books are the railway's annual reference publication for the national network; their contents were not opened in this check, so the tables they hold (for example on network, stations, rolling stock, traffic and finances) still need confirming. The site also publishes documents that bear on network assets, such as the right-of-way policy for laying optical fibre cable along the tracks and province-wise lists of commercial sites on railway land. Coverage is the national railway network of Pakistan; resolution is presumed national and divisional annual figures. Format and access: PDF downloads from the Year Book page. Licence: not stated; the site is copyright Pakistan Railways. Free. Caveats: contents were not read, PDFs need table extraction, and the site mixes tender notices with data documents. Simulation uses: annual network and traffic figures as context for rail capacity planning and resilience studies in Pakistan. Related records: no directly related records are catalogued yet.
